text:
We sent our son here with concerns regarding communication and cognitive understanding.

Within the first session the staff had demonstrated techniques we could emulate at home.

We continued with the service going several times per week, over a number of months until he was settled into school.

The staff are excellent with the children and professional with the parents.

I think the biggest impact was made with us (mum and dad).  We learnt how to use his own motivations to get him boy to follow instructions.

In terms of the impact on him.  He learnt how to learn.

His language developed quickly after that.

“First this, then that” was a game changer!  Thank you Paidi Pattaya!
One of the therapists from this firm came to see me on her day off. This firm certainly takes care of its customers. Highly recommend this place
